create_ScalarMeter: create a ScalarMeter with a window size deque to track scalar values and compute median or average
build_TrainMeter: build a TrainMeter to track training loss, top1/top5 error rates, learning rate, and timing stats per iteration
build_ValMeter: build a ValMeter to measure validation top1/top5 error rates and multi-label mAP across validation iterations
build_TestMeter: build a TestMeter to perform multi-view ensemble aggregation of clip predictions and calculate top-k accuracy
build_AVAMeter: build an AVAMeter to measure AVA dataset train val and test stats including mAP evaluation on action annotations
